Through:

 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE TUSHAR RAO GEDELA  ORDER % 17.05.2023 [ The proceeding has been conducted through Hybrid mode ]
CM APPL. 25882/2023 (Seeking condonation of delay of 16 days in filing appeal)
1. This is an application seeking condonation of delay in filing the present appeal 2.
For the reasons stated in the application, the delay of 16 days in filing the present appeal is condoned.

3. The application stands disposed of.
CM APPL. 25790/2023 (Extension of time to file court fees)
4.
This is an application seeking extension of time to affix the Court fees on the appeal.
5. For the reasons stated therein, the application is allowed.
Further time of six weeks is granted to affix the appropriate Court fees.
This is a digitally signed order.

7. This is an appeal under section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 impugning the judgment dated 19.01.2023 passed the Reference Court in LAC No. 103/23018 titled as Ranbir Singh vs.
Union of India & Anr, seeking further enhancement of the compensation amount in respect of award No.12/2005-06/DC/(NW) pertaining to the land acquired of Village Barwala, Delhi.

sentences.text:
8. Ms. Tyagi, learned counsel appearing for the appellant submits that the issue raised in the present appeal is similar to the one raised in L.A. APP No. 138/2018 titled Chander Bhan (Deceased)
Through LRs vs. Union of India and Anr, which was listed before this Court on 13.08.2018 and was admitted on same day and is now listed in the category of 'Regular Matters'.

sentences.text: 9. Issue notice.
Notice is accepted by Mr. Kalra, learned counsel appearing on behalf of respondent no.2/DDA 10.
Upon appellant taking steps by the appellant within two weeks, notice be issued to respondent no.1, by all permissible modes.
Additionally through learned counsel appearing for the respondent no.1 before the learned Reference Court.
11. Upon deposit of the entire decretal amount within six weeks from today, the operation of impugned order shall remain stayed.

12. Admit.
13.

List the present appeal in due course in the category of 'Regular Matters' alongwith L.A. APP No.
138/2018.
